initialization: Continue the in-house CNN, originally trained from random initialization. Neither arm opens a holdout or requires a mask at inference.
hypothesis: Lesion crops with surrounding context produce a useful training signal beyond rehearsal of the exact same original training images. Use only compatible PlantSeg annotations whose parents occur in both designated training splits.

selection.primary: Master validation macro-F1 across all 177 labels. Minimum gain over the original is .003. Compare selected eligible checkpoints using the original D4 policy. If an arm has no eligible single-view checkpoint, score its strongest master epoch for diagnosis.
selection.checkpoint_ties: Master unweighted loss within 1e-6, then earlier epoch
selection.field_slices: Sheikh tomato and Mduma potato grouped development, with Banu and the four affected blight labels recorded as diagnostics.
selection.stop: Complete both four-epoch arms. A qualifying candidate must also strictly beat the matched control on master macro-F1 before a repeat. Keep the frozen app model if the crop recipe fails the broad and field conditions.
